nodes.summary: A topological space $G$ is arcwise connected when for any two points $x, y \in G$ there is a continuous map $\gamma \colon \mathbb{R} \to G$ with $\gamma(0) = x$ and $\gamma(1) = y$.
nodes.title: Arcwise connected space

nodes.summary: A topological space $G$ is connected in the sense of Hausdorff when it is not the union of two disjoint nonempty closed subsets.
nodes.title: Connectedness in the sense of Hausdorff

nodes.summary: The claim that every metric group $G$ (a group with a metric for which multiplication and inversion are continuous) that is connected in the sense of Hausdorff is arcwise connected.
nodes.title: Claim of Scottish Book Problem 160, part (2)

nodes.summary: The claim of part (2) of Scottish Book Problem 160 is false: there is a metric group $G$ (a group with a metric for which multiplication and inversion are continuous) that is connected in the sense of Hausdorff but not arcwise connected, that is, there are points $x, y \in G$ such that no continuous map $\gamma \colon \mathbb{R} \to G$ has $\gamma(0) = x$ and $\gamma(1) = y$.
nodes.title: Connected metric groups need not be arcwise connected

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
